notes.title: The answer to all your questions!
notes.content:
Hello Adventurers,

The release of Worlds of Aria is getting even closer and you may have a few questions about the game! That’s why we created this FAQ and even if after reading it you still have questions, [b]feel free to ask them[/b] in the comments below.

[h2]What is Worlds of Aria?[/h2]

Worlds of Aria is a [b]light coop adventure game inspired by TTRPGs[/b], in which you need to stop the diabolical Grand Duke before he executes his plan! Choose your character, gather your party and make choices with… catastrophic repercussions. Beware, each roll of the dice can alter your destiny forever!

[h2]Coop you said?[/h2]

Absolutely! Even if you can play solo, we strongly recommend that you play Worlds of Aria with your friends with the help of the Friend’s Pass!

[h2]The Friend’s Pass?[/h2]

With the Friend’s Pass, only one person from your group of friends need to own the game in their Steam library! The other members of your group only need to download the Friend’s Pass version of Worlds of Aria to access the game.

More information [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1866980/view/4288076570025146781]here[/url].

[h2]When will the game be available?[/h2]

Worlds of Aria will be available on September 24 at 16:00 CEST/10:00 EDT. 

[h2]What will be the price?[/h2]

The [b]base game[/b] will be at 14,99€/$14,99 with a 10% discount on launch. Thee [b]Supporter edition[/b] will be available at 24,99€/$24,99 (artbook + digital OST + 4 additional characters + 2 exclusive dice skins).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41869469/e1e930ca15fc0449fd46d6b3970268d42ca6c4f8.png[/img]
[h2]In which languages will it be available?[/h2]

At launch, Worlds of Aria will be available in French, English, German and Simplified Chinese. Only French and English will be dubbed.

[h2]Who will be the narrator of the game?[/h2]

Any TTRPG needs… a narrator of course! In the French version, [b]Alba[/b] will be your narrator while in English, it will be [b]Laura Bailey [/b]who will tell your adventures. 

[previewyoutube=jS4gZ-k2Q2U;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Friend's Pass will be available at launch on September 24!
notes.content:
Hello Adventurers!

Worlds of Aria is a [b]cooperative game[/b] where you and your friends live multiple adventures: will you save the kingdom? Why not! Help a cat trapped under ruins? Absolutely! Explore a dark cave with a strange past? Well… you go first!

[b]On September 24[/b], Worlds of Aria will open its doors and you’ll be able to invite your friends to join this unique adventure thanks to the [b]Friend’s Pass[/b]!

[h2]Friend's Pass: how does it work exactly?[/h2]

It couldn’t be simpler! You'll need to:
[list]
[*] Have Worlds of Aria in your Steam Library
[*] Invite your friends to download the Friend’s Pass version for free (available on the Steam page)
[*] Create a game and share the game code with your friends
[*] Start your adventure together!
[/list]
[b][u]In short:[/u][/b] only one person need to own the game to play up to 4 players in coop thanks to the Friend's Pass!

We created Worlds of Aria to be an[b] easy and accessible way to play a TTRPG[/b] for you and your friends, whether you already played one or are absolutely unfamiliar with the concept and everything was done with that idea in mind. 

So… we’ll see you on [b]September 24 for the start of your adventure![/b]

notes.title: Which character will you play at launch?
notes.content:
Greetings Adventurers!

The release of Worlds of Aria is getting closer and closer! We wanted to introduce you to the different characters available at launch as well as the powers you'll be able to use to trick the roll of the dice 🎲

[h2]THE CHARACTERS[/h2]

In Worlds of Aria, you'll need to pick which character you'll play during the Campaign betwen 12 different choices. Would you rather be a fierce warrior or a king hiding his real age because it's a secret?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41869469/7ba5c325d78ac0738b755cd1695f88c9e30e8066.gif[/img]

On vous laisse faire votre choix ! Voici la liste complète des [b]12 personnages[/b] qui vous attendent pour le début de votre aventure :
[list]
[*] [b]Khanjar:[/b] A warrior who deserted the army after seeing too much conflicts.
[*] [b]Tarot:[/b] A mage whose spells are all random.
[*] [b]Gourmandise:[/b] A royal pastry chef with reknown success, who now wishes to live a simpler life. 
[*] [b]Grumps:[/b] An old bitter and asocial druid, able to communicate with animals.
[*] [b]Kaheena:[/b] A former slave who became a gladiator, then a pirate.
[*] [b]Alba:[/b] A bard and a storyteller, determined to live her own adventure.
[*] [b]Raoul:[/b] A bard known around the world, who happens to have quite a high number of illegitimate children.
[*] [b]Larcen:[/b] "What's yours is mine", Larcen is way more attracted by the pleasure of stealing from someone rather than possessing something. 
[*] [b]Evy:[/b] A young archeologist, curious about everything, who travel the world to look for ruins and ancient treasures. 
[*] [b]Archibald:[/b] A shady businessman, formerly affiliated to the crown of Aria. He ended up joining a group of adventurers make a fortune, but forgot his primarily objective along the way.
[*] [b]Clemovitch:[/b] The king of Mirabilia and a better strategist than a warrior. His secret? His soul is in fact 300 years old, passing down from one descendant to another through the centuries. 
[*] [b]Good Fortune:[/b] A mighty fighter and a great duellist. He always keeps his weapons close to him, and some are also whispering he may have a secret identity...
[/list]
[h2]STATS & POWERS[/h2]

Each character has its own stats and a unique power. In Worlds of Aria, multiple choices will be offered to you and you will need to use your Stealth, Crafting or Perception to successfully go through with it. Tread carefully when you select your character and make sure to have a well-balanced team!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41869469/5517d43aaeaaf0f4802cff1f0e7ca3f9ff595730.jpg[/img]

Here's a sneak peek of the [b]Powers[/b] you'll get to have in game:
[list]
[*] [b]Khanjar: [/b]Accumulate charges for each damage taken, then use them to get -15% per charge at your dice roll.
[*] [b]Tarot : [/b]Get a deck of 52 cards for the entirety of your adventure, then draw a card whenever you want to get a bonus.
[*] [b]Archibald :[/b] Pay one gold coin, and draw a bonus to improve your dice roll. 
[*] [b]Evy :[/b] Three times per Campaign, get an automatic Critical Success.
[*] And so many more to discover on September 24!
[/list]
Many more surprises will await you at the launch of Worlds of Aria, so do not hesitate to add the game to your wishlist!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1866980/Worlds_of_Aria/

In the meantime, feel free to join our [url=https://discord.com/invite/QumwzBy4nx]Discord server[/url]! Maybe you'll find your future allies for the launch 👀

notes.title: Equip new items to get better stats!
notes.content:
Hello Adventurers!

In Worlds of Aria, you live a grand adventure as you travel from one scene to another to resolve mysteries and fight enemies. To achieve that, you need to [b]roll the dice[/b] and it’s important that you succeed!

[h3]So, how can you do that?[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41869469/392fddbfae28301b040f9edda717bf97cfd51124.jpg[/img]
Well it’s simple: [b]find new items to equip on your characters![/b] By looking around in every scene you pass through and by gathering as much gold as possible, you can get new items which are more efficient and more interesting for your characters, allowing you to have more success in your dice rolls!

Each character has their own statistics: it’s up to you to [b]improve[/b] them and [b]identify[/b] which ones look more interesting to you. Would you rather improve Run and Jump or are you rather a Stealth player?

So once you’ve collected new items, [b]make haste to equip them so your stats can be improved right away![/b] Fair warning nonetheless: you can only equip two items so you need to make choices.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41869469/30869d947a6eb9786485488c617df86db7fa36fc.gif[/img]

Would you rather equip a [b]Torch[/b] to see in the dark and get a higher Perception or a [b]Rusty Sword[/b] to improve your Combat stat? But maybe you'll get to buy a [b]Scepter of Wisdom[/b] at the Merchant to get +12 in Knowledge...

The choice is up to you!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1866980/Worlds_of_Aria/

That’s all for today!

In the upcoming months, we’ll keep sharing more details about WoA, and soon enough, we’ll announce the release date! Also, do not hesitate to wishlist the game and talk about it to your friends, it helps us a ton!

notes.title: Meet the Villains in Worlds of Aria!
notes.content:
Hello Adventurers!

Worlds of Aria will let you live its stories later this year but today, we wanted to share with you a little more information about the [b]multiple villains you'll get to meet in our light fantasy RPG[/b]!

Even though we are absolutely talking about villains here, they are not the evily dark villains you may know from dark and complicated RPGs. In Worlds of Aria, you will face grandiloquent villains directly taken from a play. We're developing this game with one goal in mind: [b]to create a true TTRPG experience accessible to anyone[/b] and playable both with your family or your friends, even if you're younger (or a bit older). 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41869469/c64150de86212f68c41e4bcfa08f0f10b8f130ff.png[/img]

[u][b]In short:[/b][/u] Worlds of Aria is an adventure game easy to pick-up and filled with unexpected turn of events that will allow you to have an incredible time ✨

But first, allow us to talk to you about the Big Villain of this adventure...

[h1]GRAND DUKE[/h1]

Grand Duke the [b]main villain of the plot[/b] and he will be the one making the story moving forward. You'll try to catch him. He'll be able to escape. 

You'll meet Grand Duke right at the beginning of the game when he hires you to retrieve a mysterious artefact lost in the depths of a tomb. He will accompany you for a brief moment then trap you inside as soon as he has his hands on the prize. This horrible (!!) treason will kick off your adventure inside this colorful universe.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41869469/ca87d41f7417f4c719788685ebd6179fcbc7b3e5.jpg[/img]

While being a villain, Grand Duke is most of all a person of interest. Indeed, [b]he is the queen's counselor[/b] during the day, while he secretly plots for her demise to get the throne at night. As you may have understood it by now, he is far to be someone you can put your trust into!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41869469/e04bac927adbb0b065906f992a4516554c071c96.jpg[/img]

Grand Duke is [b]obsessed with power[/b] and he's absolutely convinced he'll be a better sovereign than the queen Julia. To succeed, he even created a cult called "The Legates" with worshippers of the Enemy God. They don't know it, but them too are being used by Grand Duke for his own profit.

[h1]SPADE[/h1]

[b]Spade is the right-hand man of Grand Duke[/b] inside the Legates but also one of the villains in the first Campaign: [b]A Bad Start to a Great Adventure[/b]. He's a former army captain who turned to the dark side...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41869469/56e2d1d0a6bc3c9df7a884bb6cc687800f0efbae.jpg[/img]

Spade wishes to help Grand Duke seize power in the kingdom, so you will meet him several times during your adventure. He's an ambiguous figure: he works for the bad guys but follows a strict code of honor. He refuses to hit below the belt and above all, he appreciates all a fight led with dignity.

[h1]THE DEMONESS[/h1]

[b]The Demoness will be your direct opponent in the second campaign[/b]. The Demoness comes from the Dimlands, a land of magic inhabited only by demons and separated from the rest of the world by a massive wall. To free her people and exact her revenge against the humans, the Demoness only has one goal in mind: [b]to destroy the city of Varna[/b]. Luckily for its inhabitants, you arrive at their rescue to prevent such event to happen!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41869469/58592f5c76774de4be3789b7cdfb4b9ab25163dc.jpg[/img]

[h1]THE DRAGON SORCERER KING[/h1]

The Dragon Sorcerer King used to rule over the island of [b]Mykronos [/b]and every ten years, would force its inhabitants to organize a large feast in his honor and dozens of tourists were invited each time. Vainquished by a group of adventurers a long time ago, everyone believe he is now dead..;

[i][b]But is he really?[/b][/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41869469/a83aad63ec77f5a9c41c2bf0df579e31e8fd39a6.png[/img]

That's all for today! Thank you so much for reading our blogpost about the [b]villains that you'll meet in Worlds of Aria[/b]! Do not hesitate to [b]wishlist the game[/b] and to talk about it to those around you, it will help us a lot!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1866980/Worlds_of_Aria/

Feel free to share your thoughts in the comments or on our [url=https://discord.gg/JZJknmH3zM]Discord server[/url].

notes.title: Digital Tabletop Fest 4 begins today and Worlds of Aria is part of it!
notes.content:

notes.title: The story in Worlds of Aria
notes.content:
Hello Adventurers and welcome to Worlds of Aria!

Today, we'll be talking about the [b]story of the game[/b], the multiple quests you may encounter and what you'll have to face in order to restore peace in the kingdoms. It may be dangerous monsters. It may also be some bees to avoid, monkeys to tame or riddles to solve.

One thing is for sure: we've got a lot of surprises for you with our game!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41869469/cef315e7d744d88bd5da8ea73ae8e7f7e51b67d3.gif[/img]

[h2]Worlds of Aria: a new adventure to experience with your friends[/h2]

Worlds of Aria is a tabletop RPG set in a [b]light fantasy universe[/b]. A great number of cultures co-exist together, with each kingdom having their own secrets and mysteries. Every day, people meet strange creatures or experience magical events. 

Their daily life is vastly different from ours. This is a world where merchants and fishermen coexist with powerful magicians, demons, brilliant scientists and ancient gods. Glotoon, the god of the sea is frequently seen by lost sailors...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41869469/fc46b7dd7e521e6071126c59086bba8541e05b9a.jpg[/img]
Daring adventurers may find relics and forgotten cities deep in the jungle during their quests, even though sometimes it's better to not trouble the sleep of the ancient power living there. Worlds of Aria is filled with surprises: one day you fight a gigantic demon, the other you find yourself participating in the festivities of an island!

[h2]Creating the world[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41869469/f5ea8fbc5e8b8ecdbb8592ce0f2fc3960a819bf7.jpg[/img]
[b]Worlds of Aria[/b] is adapted from a famous tabletop web series in France, created by [b]FibreTigre[/b]. His main inspiration to create this world is the book series [i]Sorcery[/i], written by Steve Jackson in the 1980s. These adventure gamebooks introduced more mechanics to the genre, especially with the possibility to play a warrior or a wizard. It may seem obvious to us now in 2023, but it wasn't the case back then!

At Ludogram, we were looking for something both efficient with its story and also able to adapt to different styles. We found the perfect inspiration with [i]Tintin[/i], the famous belgian reporter, but we didn't stop there! We looked for more inspirations, more things to help us bring our ideas to life. Thus, we took a little from:
[list]
[*] [b][i]Indiana Jones[/i][/b] for the rythm and the variety of the scenes
[*] [b][i]Astérix & Obélix[/i][/b] for the comedy and how the characters are conceived
[*] [b][i]Tolkien[/i][/b] of course, for the epic fantasy adventure
[/list]
[h2]Your story, your character[/h2]

Everyone can become a true adventurer in Worlds of Aria but [b]nobody's perfect[/b]. From an overpowered warrior to a shady trader, or even a clumsy mage, like the one we've seen in the recent Dungeons & Dragons movie. Everyone is a little selfish and this is absolutely something you can emphasize when playing with your friends.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41869469/a0625dbe95a1ecda7d1f56e801a37baa5eade08e.png[/img]
In Worlds of Aria, all the characters are slightly off the mark. They're aside from society and they all have a distinct caracteristic that make them truly peculiar and really essential to the rest of the group.

[h2]Four campaigns, one distinct villain[/h2]

Each new campaign will take you on a journey to a [b]different kingdom[/b], with its own unique atmosphere and storyline. From the get go, you'll be running after [b]Grand-Duke[/b], the mastermind behind every problem in Worlds of Aria!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41869469/be017976033388d836c62a2f5499268a026bd344.png[/img]

[list]
[*] In the [b]first campaign[/b], dive into the large city of Aria and stop a conspiracy against the Queen. The future of the kingdom lies in your hands! Meet multiple characters and smuggle your way inside the palace.
[*] The [b]second campaign[/b] will see your adventurers set foot on a desertic land, home to supernatural beings and demons. Travel from one side of the kingdom to another and learn how to become a real demon hunter.
[*] The [b]third one[/b] will bring a radical change to your adventure. Join the island of Mykronos with a mix of mediteranean and tropical atmospheres as you try to catch Grand-Duke while he's on the run. Will you be able to catch him as you jump from one charming location to a dangerous one?
[*] And the [b]last campaign[/b]? Well, we prefer not to say much about it but... the story revolves around the mysterious World of Dreams!
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41869469/2550115815b900c7c4bfd2933a0ece9223f19c5c.png[/img]
[h2]A world of adventures[/h2]

Worlds of Aria will get you to live a grand adventure, filled with epic moments and ludicrous ones. Who said you couldn't have a conspiracy to prevent and a very difficult chicken to catch in the same campaign? Both are important!

[b]Our goal is to surprise players[/b], and we really hope we succeeded in doing so! See for yourselves, try the demo and call your friends to join you on this special adventure!

notes.content:

We have some news to share with you regarding the release of Worlds of Aria. The quality performance and the gameplay of Worlds of Aria is one of our top priorities, and we need just a bit more time to ensure that we release the game that you deserve to have.

notes.title: August development news | The Merchant's interlude
notes.content:
Hello, Adventurers,

In previous devlogs, we explained how to use the inventory and items in Worlds of Aria. Let’s recap what you can do with them:

[list]
[*] Store an item in your inventory
[*] Equip an item
[*] Consum an item
[*] Pass an item to your friends’ inventory — you won’t be able to take it back though
[*] Use items during object phases to trade them
[/list]

As we are still improving this feature of the game right now, we are happy to introduce a new scene we've started to develop since the beginning of July: [b]the merchant interlude![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41869469/1699f6f6533b767e14cadc63ccf1c78eb88d2fb5.png[/img]

[h3]What is it about?[/h3]

As you progress through the game, you’ll collect more and more items. And your inventory has limited slots.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41869469/d70138b034068689e5b9465172040a23cd6486ce.gif[/img]

This scene will allow you to sell your unused items for coins, or if you feel like you need special equipment because you were unsuccessful during dice roll phases for example, you’ll be able to buy equipment or consumable objects that’ll help you continue your adventure peacefully.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41869469/49e33006d917858d33b909fece286839a3ebc6c3.png[/img]

That’s why you also need to manage your gold! You can still try to convince your friends to lend you money so you can buy something…

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41869469/3b1b607a192e3188411bcedf89fbea2c6760dca1.gif[/img]

notes.title: Production point of July | Meet the demoness !
notes.content:
Hello adventurers! 

Worlds of Aria is full of dangerous places... And yet, you'll need to explore them anyways! In this blogpost, we will introduce two of the most ferocious fantastic creatures living there. Now you're aware of it, you must plan a solid fighting strategy!

[h3]Meet the demoness![/h3]

[b]Scene recap[/b]

[i]The scene takes place in Cat's Alley, a large royal alley linking the wall gate to Varna's palace.[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41869469/1a93612525db2f91c9a719383879a798c1d7eaaa.gif[/img]

Our heroes arrived in Varna and stumbled upon a demoness that broke the big wall's gate! With the help of 3 other mages, they must repel her so they can cast a powerful spell that will build up a protection barrier surrounding the city.

Axare, King of Varna, asks the heroes to find a warlock in Eistenpoli. This is the only person able to annihilate the demoness for good...

[b]Getting ready for the fight[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41869469/b8dac5dfc2635ae43e195fa69b7f90e0f26eaf83.gif[/img]

The mages of Varna explain that the heroes must repel the demoness and lead them to the door.

The demoness will attack the mages during two choice phases. It is possible to help them but... you could lose some HP in return!

You'll get ready for the fight during the first choice phase. A mage offers a recovering spell, another a shield spell or you can look for loot and so on.

Careful, the demoness will have more than one trick up her sleeve!

[b]Fighting the demoness[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41869469/2a9928a1a27229f92b58a348a180bd13dad64001.gif[/img]

You need to protect the mages of Varna! If you fail, one of them will perish. If they all perish, it's a game over!

When the demoness grabs someone, they're captured and cannot move. A choice will enable other players to set them free. But if players fail, the hand will take the character away.

Don't make a fool of yourself, you could be the next standing between her claws!

[h3]Another creature ?[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41869469/03dbc20048efda13d5d1d2d253f0ff17f45db3e8.gif[/img]

You might come across another creature during your adventure: the sea king Glooton!

Who is it? It is a divinity living sleepily in the Biting Sea, close to the Aria palace. As a capricious soul, it likes that humans flatter, make offerings, or beg it. But if you ask it for a service without begging, he'll destroy your boat without warning.

You'll meet him only if you are brave enough and unleash your creative potential!

notes.title: Production point of June | World Map & new environments
notes.content:
Hello, Adventurers!

Almost 2,000 of you have played Worlds of Aria demo and provided us with feedback that will enable us to improve many aspects of the game, for which we'd like to thank you wholeheartedly! We'll make sure to listen to your feedback to make the experience clearer and more fun.

[h2]The market scene: before vs after[/h2]

[h3]A whole new structure[/h3]

An Ulule backer wrote the quest which is the following: Luxphos, a biologist, offers the group to pay for their toll if they find his precious black hen: Hennifer.

As they are looking for the hen, they stumble upon the chicken coop of a skewer merchant: Iznoflood Patrosou. The group will interact with Iznoflood through different choices, discreetly figure out how to infiltrate the coop, and finally coordinate with each other to catch the hen.

Depending on their choices, they will catch the hen back or return empty-handed. When they come back to the toll, the group can choose between giving the hen back to Luxphos or keeping her to themselves.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41869469/25f6eac046e48554882caab24bd278ea7f763f3c.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41869469/956c2dfe5171601ff9f6f483b5a624ed98b62363.gif[/img]

[h3]Environment polish[/h3]

If you follow us on [url=https://twitter.com/LudogramGames]Twitter[/url], you may have noticed that the market environment and its narrative ark have changed! We added more environment-related designs, items to collect, and new environmental interactions as if you were there!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41869469/21f5f0005f7451986537c69a2f269f324358cd5b.gif[/img]

[h3]A new object phase[/h3]

The market scene is the more profitable scene! You can earn up to 20 coins and a golden egg depending on the choices! You can earn back a lot of HP as well.

In this new object phase, Iznoflood announces a skewer contest. By dragging the object and consuming them, the player who will eat the more skewers will get a reward! They will get closer to the ultimate goal: taking Hennifer back, locked in the chicken coop.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41869469/7178b193635e95235adb7d85e7948c35fa449d70.gif[/img]

[h2]Others[/h2]

[h3]The World Map[/h3]

The World Map gives a short preview of the geographical context of the narration. On the map fresco, you can see a scrolling scenery, whose each geographical element represents a scene, symbolically. The characters float through the fresco for a few seconds from the previous scene to the next one. This is a small theatrical piece that introduces new elements and transitions from one scene to another.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41869469/56985de6fcad2ebebb377f6460de2023ed6cdd42.gif[/img]

[h3]Enjoy the demo![/h3]

If you have not played the demo yet, don't forget to gather your bravest adventurers with the [url=”https://steamcommunity.com/app/1866980/discussions/0/3834296416930672113/”]Remote Play Together[/url] to dive into the Aria universe, where everything is possible, including betraying your companions...

We want your feedback to improve the game, so feel free to share your thoughts on our [url=”https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSf415QAUIT3NlfBGBLUocrHnXBF9GaEIm1w6x0gToqfF6ySmA/viewform”]feedback form[/url].

notes.title: Production point of May | The trading system
notes.content:
Hello Adventurers!

The journey will not be easy... This update will help you to regain energy, hoping that you will have the right resources to restore yourself!

[h3]The trading system[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41869469/795c1bdb03fe7762b56f15d6ebe86c89a4d0e547.gif[/img]

[b]Reworking the trading system and imagining new mechanisms[/b]

The old paid choices system no longer exists! Instead, we’ve turned it into a trading system that will allow you to give an item that you previously added to your inventory to solve a situation. You can give an object through a drag-and-drop, or keep it for yourself and continue the adventure. There will be consequences in both cases!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41869469/32a0bf92684e0482b86b2924568592e7538e636d.gif[/img]

[h3]Revamping and tweaking the existing inventory[/h3]

Players will finally be able to collect and add items or money to their inventory! Each person owns their inventory that can only be opened and managed by themselves.

To place an item in your inventory, you need to drag it on your character and drop it, then you’ll have in-real-time feedback about your actions. You can also take them out, put them back on the ground so your friends can transfer the items to their own inventories, and so on.

There will be 3 ways to use the items from your inventory:

[list]
[*] to trade them
[*] to consume them
[*] to pass them on to your friends.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41869469/f0aa9e7ea241e21892352cd857049a8d8c7aab25.gif[/img]

[h3]Informing about the objects better[/h3]

As we try to make the whole storage and item system clearer, we need to make the inventory clear in the first place. That is why you’ll have a slot dedicated to money only, with the amount you own and the rest are 5 slots to welcome the items. By passing the cursor over the object, you’ll see how many HP it will cost!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41869469/fd09598adc75bc38888b1257f1e145468c5ee392.png[/img]

By hovering over a figurine with an item in hand, you’ll have an action tooltip popping up as well as a colored outline, depending on the character hovering over it. The text will also appear differently depending on whether the person owns the inventory or not.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41869469/81a8873c6bce3ba5844202b6074c6b3c959ea4a1.png[/img]

To store an item in the inventory, all you need to do is to drag and drop it on the figurine, if there’s some space left. If you equip the item, a small indicator “equipped” will pop up below the figurine to notify you about it. For regular storage, a small “+1” will pop.


[h3]Adding new HUD elements[/h3]

Elements allowing to receive objects, such as environmental elements, a prop, or a character, will be outlined if someone passes their cursor on it.

There will be responses such as a dialog box, a visual effect, alterations, damage, or loot.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41869469/a15713e7b86a859b57cb4ef3cd55e79a51c60a75.gif[/img]

[h3]Other[/h3]

[b]Working on the next hero[/b]

Work In Progress: Introducing the King of Varna 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41869469/e0a1872cd50d6d52e4f9b83a910627e339aef277.png[/img]

Axare King rules Varna with an iron fist. He is a strict, rigorous but genuine man that hates lies. In fact, his sword’s blade will shine if he is in the presence of a liar. To him, nothing can excuse such a crime, and will claim the highest sentence. However, he can show a lot of kindness and generosity to the people who are worth it and the people in need.

notes.title: How to manage the new inventory system?
notes.content:
[h3]👜 An inventory system to fill your pockets[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41869469/7a8044ac515d100b9679b62850915e3117de7f1a.gif[/img]
Your character's inventory will be a valuable resource throughout the game [b]to collect consumable items, equipment or money[/b]!

Each player will own their own inventory. [b]It can only be opened by them, not by others[/b]. You will need to consider a good storage strategy since the places will be limited!

With the drag-and-drop system, there are 3 ways to use the objects:
[olist]
[*] during objects phases—when objects spawn during a scene
[*] as consumable objects
[*] to pass them from one player to another
[/olist]

If you drop an object on the ground, anybody can pick it up. So, beware of those who might take your resources to achieve their own goals...

[h3]✨ Effects and alterations[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41869469/5a1e2ca164225bf57a6b99fddcf32c6bcd5a350e.gif[/img]
Temporary effects will give a bonus or malus to your character! Depending on its origin, it will last more or less time—maybe your will be cursed until the end of your campaign! The alteration displays directly in your character sheet. By moving the cursor on the alteration icon, you'll find out more details about the effects.

notes.title: Closed Alpha for the first Adventurers and new 3D effects!
notes.content:
[h3]🔐 The closed alpha welcomes its first Aria citizens![/h3]

Worlds of Aria opens its doors very soon… To the bravest of you only! The Ulule backers will be the first to pass these doors. Maybe you'll miss this journey for now, but keep those swords high, your turn will come!

You'll be able to:
[list]
[*] Face all the dangers of the first scenario
[*] Create your own group locally or online
[*] Gather some coins
[*] Roll a maximum of [strike]damage[/strike] critical successes!
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41869469/e59d7233937e5ce8366b350d7c71126d9eab52fb.gif[/img]

[b]Why a closed alpha?[/b]

These players will play with a common objective: participating in the development and improving the game experience with their feedback. It is essential to satisfy all the players when the game will be out!

[h3]🪄 Magic & 3D effects[/h3]

The game will never get enough magic! Your companions won't be the only ones to mess with you... Be careful about the environment too, you could be surprised! And another little piece of advice: choose your equipment wisely, it might save your life. Just saying in case, you know, something happens.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41869469/47455e7c7eb1ba26b9ce74808f46d446e1ae7af5.gif[/img]

notes.title: Let's bring some light and emotions...
notes.content:
[h3]🔥 Let the light in![/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41869469/ffa11643cbffb8672a5a6a3324ba2315b2c42fc9.gif[/img]
Sometimes in Worlds of Aria, you'll go through dark places… But, hey, don't panic! Our team didn't forget the most fearful of you! This means that we imagined [b]new light effects[/b]. If you use them, they will guide you through Aria! 

Why some lights? To be guided in the dark, highlight hidden things, create an atmosphere, blind your enemies or troll your friend... We leave their various purposes to your imagination!

Will the lantern be your [i]best[/i] or [i]worst[/i] friend in the Worlds of Aria?

[h3]🎭 An emote, an emotion[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41869469/6a34fc17ac28432b64009cc333263ed0d9eac4c7.gif[/img]
The heroes in the Worlds of Aria will have emotions too. Love, anger, surprise, thoughts... Emotions have a meaning, just like words! They give form to a line... Unless you misread them, in this way you may cause discord!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1866980/Worlds_of_Aria/

notes.title: Ishtar Games becomes the publisher of Worlds of Aria
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

We—the Ludogram team—have been developing Worlds of Aria since 2021. We were open to the possibility of being supported by a publisher. And here we are: [b]Ishtar Games will become the publisher of Worlds of Aria[/b]!

[h3]How will Ishtar contribute to the game?[/h3]
[list]
[*]Ishtar Games will help us with reaching an international audience
[*]They’ll also assist us with the multi-platform distribution
[*]Worlds of Aria will be localized in several languages
[*]You’ll still be able to chat with the dev team, but the publisher will also support us with important announcements
[/list]
